$description: TreeSelect (platform/components/TreeSelect, library wave 7, lane C): its component tokens. The trigger is the text field's look (input tokens), the panel a Popover (popover tokens) and the rows the Tree's (tree tokens).

tree-select-max-width.$description: TreeSelect: the widest the field grows (as the Combobox).

tree-select-trigger-padding-inline-end.$description: TreeSelect: the room after the chosen text for the chevron (as the Combobox).

tree-select-placeholder-text.$description: TreeSelect: the text while nothing is chosen.

tree-select-chevron-color.$description: TreeSelect: the chevron at the field's end.

tree-select-chevron-inset-inline-end.$description: TreeSelect: the chevron's distance from the field's end.

tree-select-panel-gap.$description: TreeSelect: the space between the search field and the tree.

tree-select-scroll-max-height.$description: TreeSelect: the tallest the tree grows before it scrolls.

tree-select-empty-text.$description: TreeSelect: No matches, when the search keeps nothing.

tree-select-empty-font-size.$description: TreeSelect: the size of No matches.

tree-select-empty-padding-block.$description: TreeSelect: the space above and under No matches.
